newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bear Stearns gets Irish banking licence.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns gets Irish banking licence.

text.p: The Bear Stearns Companies Inc said on Monday that it had received a banking licence from Ireland's central bank for the operation of Bear Stearns Bank Plc in Dublin's International Financial Services Centre.
Bear Stearns said in a statement that its Irish unit, which will be primarily engaged in non U.S.-based capital markets activities, will open for business within the next few weeks.
"We are delighted to have obtained our banking licence. Initially we will be targeting fixed income derivative activities," Bear Stearns executive vice president Warren Spector said.
Spector said he expects Bear Stearns Bank Plc will enable the group to widen its world-wide customer base and expand the range of services that it offers to international clients.
Bear Stearns is an investment banking and securities trading and brokerage firm with more than $10.6 billion in total capital, the statement said.
